label: Consultation Workbench
headline: Overview route is live; consultation delivery remains module-gated
summary: This overview is a truthful landing surface for the Consultation Workbench. It exposes existing support surfaces and the remaining module-level BFF gaps without claiming that consult requests, committee boards, or red-team memo flows are already live.

packet_family.note: All four Consultation Workbench modules remain blocked on net-new BFF routes or lifecycle contracts.
